reviews.author: Chandra mouli Kare
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. The consultation was expensive, the prescribed medicines were costly, and I was not properly informed about important usage instructions. When I went back because my condition had worsened, the response from the doctor was rude and unprofessional. I eventually had to seek treatment from another doctor. I expected better care and better communication.

Patients visit doctors for medical advice and proper guidance. Clear instructions should be given during the consultation, especially when prescribing strong medications. I expected compassion and doctor behavior was very disappointing.

When I asked why I wasn't warned about the strong medication, I was simply told that I should have checked it myself. The doctor then said, "What can we do now? We can't file a case against the manufacturer." This was very disappointing and unprofessional.

A doctor should listen to patients, explain how to use medicines safely, and respond with empathy when complications occur. Sadly, that was not my experience. I had to consult another doctor to recover.
